task_fulfillment.rationale: The Word deliverable provides substantive executive negotiation content, sincere engagement, ZOPA, alternatives, tooling treatment and commercial levers. Material corrections are needed before use: the operative schedule places the bridge and development kick-offs after cessation, lacks a Day-21 decision gate, mixes incompatible development-date baselines, and assumes bridge-dependent overlap without a complete no-extension route. Immediate-cessation planning and the required three-week checklist are incomplete. Reconfirmation of the already-governing R2 is unnecessary but not expressly a blocking hold. No companion files were supplied. Page count and rendered usability remain unverified, separately from these substantive failures.
